verdict.rationale: Persona documents recurring scheduling for reports: reports "can be configured to run in regular intervals against an account," such as a monthly or yearly Watchlist Report. Workflows automate decisions and start from "several trigger types," but the evidence never shows a schedule or cron-style trigger for workflows, so recurring scheduling is shown only for reports. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/time-based workflow triggers, API-level control of recurring schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
